text:
Lina: Morning team — quick weekly check on Truesight caching/batching. Noticed hit rate down to 18% this week (was 31% last week).

Matt: Thanks. I pulled the metrics — avg batch size 3.2 -> target 5; median latency 130ms; p95 420ms; 4xx errors up 0.4% -> 1.2%.

Matt: ```
window: 2026-03-12 to 2026-03-18
hit_rate: 18.2%
avg_batch_size: 3.2
cost_per_1k_tokens: $2.45 (up 14%)
token_volume: 4.6M
errors_total: 55 (1.2%)
```

Jess: Noted the cost jump — likely due to low batching + no prefix cache. Any recent routing/model changes?

Ana: We rolled model -> redwood-large-v2 on 2026-03-15 for better quality. That variant has slightly different tokenization overhead and larger KV sizes.

Matt: Right — runtime kernel/seq utilization shifted. Suggest: enable prefix caching for top 3 routes and bump batch target to 5. I can push a config to dedupe short-lived prefixes.

Lina: Can you estimate cost delta if we recover hit rate and batch size?

Matt: Estimated: moving hit_rate to ~45% and avg_batch to 5 -> cost_per_1k_tokens -> approx $1.58. Rough calc below.

Matt: ```
baseline_cost = $2.45
expected_hit_increase = +27%
expected_batch_gain = 1.8x
estimated_cost = $1.58 per 1k
(note: excludes small model-variant delta)
```

Jess: Any risk to tail latency if we increase batching? p95 might go up.

Matt: We plan adaptive batching: target 5, max wait 60ms, and a p95 guard at 350ms. If p95 breaches, rollout auto-fallback to batch target 3.

Lina: Action items: 1) Matt — enable prefix cache on routes A/B/C + set batch target 5 with adaptive settings. 2) Jess — monitor p95, error rate, and cost for 24h and report. 3) Ana — prepare a short note for Truesight AM summarizing expected savings + QA risk.

Ana: Will draft and send to AM by EOD.

deploy-bot: config-change queued: prefix_cache=true routes=[A,B,C] batch_target=5 adaptive_wait_ms=60 p95_guard_ms=350; CI pipeline started.

Matt: I will watch dashboards (latency, hit rate, cost per 1k) and post a follow-up in this thread tomorrow morning.

Lina: :thumbsup:

Jess: Quick note — I'll also add a small eval prompt set to ensure redwood-large-v2 quality stays within regression bounds after caching.

Matt: Good call. If anything odd shows up I’ll roll config back and notify.

Lina: Thanks team. Keeping this thread for follow-up.
